summary: Recovery metadata can be overwritten by a later state update in the same successful poll.
inspection_summary: Failure metadata, Mission Control fields, and failure/recovery audit events exist, but subsequent reconciler writers replace metadata.eve_note_reconciler.
judgment_delta: Transient failure visibility is implemented; durable recovery visibility still needs merge-preserving metadata updates.

findings.detail: markCandidateWait, closeDispatchRun, or blockCandidateWriteBack can replace the reconciler metadata written by markStreamReadRecovered in the same poll.
